name: i.safe MOBILE IS940.2
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS940.2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 10.1-inch Android tablet from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 14.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2025-03-31), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX per DoC.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: NEC 500: Class I Div 2 Groups A, B, C, D T4; Class II Div 2 Groups F, G 155 °C; Class III

safety.conditions: Battery may be replaced outside explosion hazardous areas only; protect against excessive UV light and high electrostatic charge; USB-C interface under IP cover opened only outside hazardous areas; 16-pin ISM interface closed with cover when not in use in hazardous areas; ambient −20 °C to +55 °C; charging temperature 0 °C to +45 °C (IECEx EPS 25.0002X). Safety instructions: only zones 2/22.
safety.peripherals: USB-C and 16-pin ISM covers closed in Ex areas; the 12-pin dock interface may stay open and the IS-DS940.1 dock or approved accessories may be connected there. 16-pin ISM accessories only outside Ex areas unless listed as approved for Ex-area use (headset, PTT button).
safety.certifiedAccessories: As IS-940.1: IS-HS2A.1, IS-PTTB1A.1, IS-HDHS1x.1 headsets, IS-DS940.1 dock, multi charger, leather cases, vehicle mount.

specs.display: 10.1-inch Corning Gorilla Glass V3 (3rd generation), usable with gloves
specs.ports: USB-C; 12-pin docking interface; 16-pin ISM interface (audio/PTT accessories; the page text also calls it '13-pin'); nano-SIM + eSIM; microSD
specs.docking: IS-DS940.1 docking station (VESA 100; charging in Ex area); IS-MC930.1 six-bay multi charger; vehicle mount
specs.gnss: GPS, A-GPS, Glonass, A-Glonass, Beidou, Galileo
specs.keys: Freely programmable red key (e.g. lone worker / SOS); additional programmable side buttons
specs.touch: Usable with gloves (maker); wet-touch not stated
specs.pen: Passive stylus available as accessory (IS-Stylus Set, 'stylus for operating touch screens'); not in the box
specs.partNumbers: Model M940A01; battery BPIS940A.2A per DoC

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via accessory (IS-PTTB1A.1 PTT button on the 16-pin ISM interface; Ex-rated? yes) and PTT app

capabilities.label: Emergency / SOS
capabilities.value: Built in (freely programmable red key, e.g. SOS / lone worker)

capabilities.label: Lone worker
capabilities.value: Via app (red key assigned to a lone-worker application; third-party app)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (50 MP camera-based; no dedicated scan engine listed)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras, Wi-Fi 6 / 5G; third-party app)

strengths: May be charged inside the hazardous area, within the certificate's limits
ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 2 in North America
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
